sources.title: Arsenal team news: Gabriel one of six ruled out
sources.citation_excerpt: Gabi unfortunately picked up an injury ... and he's going to be out for weeks.
sources.claim_text: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta confirmed Gabriel would miss the derby and remain out for weeks.

adjustment.rationale: Confirmed multi-week absence makes the player unavailable for GW12.

sources.title: FPL Gameweek 12 team news: Friday injury updates
sources.citation_excerpt: I really don't know if he's going to be available for tomorrow or not.
sources.claim_text: Bournemouth manager Andoni Iraola was uncertain whether Antoine Semenyo's ankle would allow him to play.

adjustment.rationale: Material ankle doubt receives the maximum bounded start-probability reduction, not an unavailable flag.
